Editorial Portfolio & Private Tutoring

Time to build the structure of your thoughts and find answers in sentences of your own

Hello, I am HoonQ Kang. I offer personalized 1-on-1 tutoring for both students and adults, while documenting my ongoing learning and daily reflections through essays and photography. Rather than standardized rote memorization, I focus on cultivating the ability to ask questions independently and solve problems logically.


What kind of education can AI never replace? My vitality and lived experience!!! While AI can mimic a bright tone and feign experience, it still lacks true authenticity. I explore and embody what it means to be genuinely human.
